definition.text: A process in which a host organism initiates, promotes, or enhances the normal execution of a biological process being mediated by a virus with which it is infected.

synonyms.name: positive regulation by host of viral process

definition.text: A process of exocytosis in which soluble proteins and other substances are initially stored in secretory vesicles for later release. It is found mainly in cells that are specialized for secreting products such as hormones, neurotransmitters, or digestive enzymes rapidly on demand.

results.name: spermatid nucleus differentiation

definition.text: The specialization of the spermatid nucleus during the development of a spermatid into a mature male gamete competent for fertilization.

results.comment: See also the Cell Ontology term 'spermatid ; CL:0000018'.

definition.text: Control of the spatial distribution of intermediate filaments; includes organizing filaments into meshworks, bundles, or other structures, as by cross-linking.
